correctness.rationale: Direct basis substitution forces R(c) to be central and leaves the single equation (y-x)z=xy-lambda x+uv. The finite-field fiber counts use only the standard counts for uv=t. The determinant reduces exactly to x^2(y+z-lambda), and the invertible formulas follow from counting the zero-product subloci. Exhaustive direct identity checks over small prime fields reproduce every formula.
